drawn_from: conformance.pumpkin.json absent_workspace_wide, run of 2026-08-21 after the nested-class and fn-less-file fixes
method: each lead verified by reading the vanilla method in ~/pumpkin-vanilla-26.2/decompiled AND grepping the Rust side; no verdict is from memory

leads.evidence: LookControl.java:89 returns Optional<Float> pitch delta; crates/pumpkin/src/entity/ai/control/look_control.rs:123 fn get_target_pitch(&self, mob) -> Option<f32> is the same method in the same mapped file. Add to CLASS_METHOD_ALIASES.

BellBlock.java:284 returns false unconditionally. Pumpkin classifies pathability centrally in entity/ai/pathfinder/walk_node_evaluator.rs with no per-block override and no Bell special case (rg Bell over pathfinder/ is empty).

Phantom.java:139 overrides with an empty body, i.e. phantoms never take fall damage. living.rs:2014 fall / :2060 handle_fall_damage / :1510 is_immune_to_fall_damage exist generically but phantom.rs carries no override.
entity/passive/sheep.rs:245 async fn shear() does the drop directly; there is no generic shearing-loot hook on LivingEntity here.
CampfireBlock.java:168 spawns smoke particles and plays the crackle from RandomSource on the client tick; unreachable on a dedicated server. Belongs in CLIENT_ONLY_METHODS.
MangroveRootPlacer.java:128 is the per-block helper called from placeRoots; pumpkin-world/src/generation/feature/features/tree/root/mangrove.rs:148 fn place_roots does the same work inline.

Block.java:422 ejects a stack out of a given face with face-derived velocity (crafter, dispenser-less drops). Pumpkin has only world/mod.rs:6343 drop_stack, the popResource equivalent; no directional variant anywhere.
No post-load promotion step exists in pumpkin-world/src/chunk/mod.rs. Lower confidence than the others: the chunk pipeline differs structurally, so this may be a not-applicable rather than a fill.
No counterpart in pumpkin-world/src/generation/structure/template/structure_template.rs; structure placement does not re-run shape updates on the placed volume's border.
pumpkin-data/src/smithing.rs is a generated table; the template ingredient is a field of the generated row, not a method.
pumpkin-data/src/generated/chunk_status.rs holds the ordered status list as generated data.
pumpkin-world/src/level.rs:127 pub fluid_ticks: Vec<OrderedTick<&'static Fluid>> - a field, reached directly at :624/:627. The accessor has no reason to exist in Rust.
rg implicit over crates returns no component machinery. Same shape as the ShelfBlockEntity.applyImplicitComponents gap confirmed in the seed-2108 sample.

StructurePiece.java:121 intersects the piece box with a chunk box expanded by a margin. pumpkin-world/src/generation/structure/structures/mod.rs has bounding_box/translate/place but no margin-intersection test.

Mob.java:1069 enchants spawned armour at 0.5 power scaled by local difficulty. Pumpkin's entity tree has equipment attribute/drop handling (living.rs:471, :2310) but nothing that enchants equipment at spawn.
